query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS track_reposts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  trackId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX track_reposts_user_id_idx (userId),
  INDEX track_reposts_track_id_idx (trackId),
  UNIQUE INDEX track_reposts_unique (userId, trackId)
);
